releaseNotes:
Initial release: import OpenAPI/Swagger and Postman Collection v2.1 into a searchable endpoint catalog tree with per-endpoint parameter/body/schema browsing, cURL copy and Markdown export.

0.1.1: declare host.storage (persistence previously failed silently in the sandbox), add LICENSE, fix manifest $schema branch.
name: polaris-api
description: API asset library: import OpenAPI/Swagger and Postman Collections into a searchable catalog tree; browse method, path, parameters, request body and response schemas per endpoint; one-click cURL copy and Markdown export.

zh-CN.name: polaris-api
zh-CN.description: API 资产库：从 OpenAPI/Swagger 与 Postman Collection 导入接口，整理为可搜索的目录树；浏览每个接口的方法、路径、参数、请求体与响应 Schema，一键复制 cURL、导出 Markdown。
